author: Sega Jenesis
title: Looking for digital artists for Pokémon card binder scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 Contact: DM on Threads. Still looking for more artists as of recent update.

author: v.m.sawh
title: Indie Author seeking character artists for dark fantasy book
content: Attn Artists: I'm an Indie Author looking for experienced character artists for an exciting 2027 dark fantasy book with 10+ full page colour illustrations in a 6x9" hardcover interior. Artists, please link your portfolios. Criteria: 1) NO AI. Real artists only 2) Your portfolio must include at least one Creature/Werewolf/Demon and one Beautiful Woman to be considered 3) Semi/Realistic Illustrations (colour and B&W) 4) Canadian Artists preferred 5) Vibe Check: https://pin.it/15teNuksT Contact via replies with portfolios or DM.
